entity_types.name: Product
entity_types.description: Finished furniture item sold in the catalog and reviewed by customers, excluding sub-assemblies and individual replacement parts.

entity_types.name: Component
entity_types.description: Individual hardware part, material, surface, or structural member of a product, excluding the fully assembled finished product itself.

entity_types.name: Defect
entity_types.description: Physical imperfection, material failure, functional malfunction, or transit damage observed in a product or component, excluding subjective styling preferences and user comfort ratings.

entity_types.name: AssemblyIssue
entity_types.description: Procedural difficulty, instructional error, or physical impediment experienced during product assembly, excluding normal wear and tear after successful assembly.

fact_types.description: Indicates that a component part belongs to the reviewed product, derived automatically from the document context.
Links a specific component part to an observed physical flaw, damage, or functional failure.
Links a finished product to an observed defect or damage upon arrival that is not isolated to a specific component.
Identifies an assembly complication, documentation flaw, or assembly failure encountered with a product.
Indicates that a physical or manufacturing defect directly resulted in an assembly difficulty or assembly failure.
